function icon.setState(p14, p15: string, p16, p17)
	if not p15 then
		p15 = if p14.isSelected then "Selected" else "Deselected"
	end

	local v68 = utility.formatStateName(p15)

	if p14.activeState == v68 then
		return
	end

	local isSelected = p14.isSelected

	p14.activeState = v68

	if v68 == "Deselected" then
		p14.isSelected = false

		if isSelected then
			p14.toggled:Fire(false, p16, p17)
			p14.deselected:Fire(p16, p17)
		end

		p14:_setToggleItemsVisible(false, p16, p17)
	elseif v68 == "Selected" then
		p14.isSelected = true

		if not isSelected then
			p14.toggled:Fire(true, p16, p17)
			p14.selected:Fire(p16, p17)
			v19:Fire(p14, p16, p17)
		end

		p14:_setToggleItemsVisible(true, p16, p17)
	end

	p14.stateChanged:Fire(v68, p16, p17)
end
function icon.getInstance(p18, p19)
	local v72 = p18.cachedNamesToInstances[p19]

	if v72 then
		return v72
	end

	v72 = function(p20, p21)
		if not p18.cachedInstances[p21] then
			local collective = p21:GetAttribute("Collective")
			local v286 = collective and p18.cachedCollectives[collective]

			if v286 then
				table.insert(v286, p21)
			end

			p18.cachedNamesToInstances[p20] = p21
			p18.cachedInstances[p21] = true
			p21.Destroying:Once(function()
				p18.cachedNamesToInstances[p20] = nil
				p18.cachedInstances[p21] = nil
			end)
		end
	end

	local widget = p18.widget

	v72("Widget", widget)

	if p19 == "Widget" then
		return widget
	end

	local u74 = nil

	local function scanChildren(p22)
		for _, v in pairs(p22:GetChildren()) do
			local widgetUID = v:GetAttribute("WidgetUID")

			if not widgetUID or widgetUID == p18.UID then
				local v291 = themes.getRealInstance(v)

				if v291 then
					v = v291
				end

				scanChildren(v)

				if v:IsA("GuiBase") or v:IsA("UIBase") or v:IsA("ValueBase") then
					local vName = v.Name

					v72(vName, v)

					if vName == p19 then
						u74 = v
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	scanChildren(widget)

	return u74
end

		local collective = k:GetAttribute("Collective")

		if p24 == collective then
			table.insert(v78, k)
		end
	end

	p23.cachedCollectives[p24] = v78

	return v78
end

function icon.align(p79, p80, p81)
	local lowerText = tostring(p80):lower()

	if lowerText == "mid" or lowerText == "centre" then
		lowerText = "center"
	end

	if lowerText ~= "left" and lowerText ~= "center" and lowerText ~= "right" then
		lowerText = "left"
	end

	local v152 = lowerText == "center" and icon.container.TopbarCentered or icon.container.TopbarStandard
	local holders = v152.Holders
	local stringUpper = string.upper
	local v155 = string.sub(lowerText, 1, 1)
	local v156 = stringUpper(v155)

	v155 = string.sub(lowerText, 2)

	local s1: string = v156 .. v155

	if not p81 then
		p79.originalAlignment = s1
	end

	local joinedFrame = p79.joinedFrame

	v156 = holders[s1]
	p79.screenGui = v152
	p79.alignmentHolder = v156

	if not p79.isDestroyed then
		p79.widget.Parent = joinedFrame or v156
	end

	p79.alignment = s1
	p79.alignmentChanged:Fire(s1)
	icon.iconChanged:Fire(p79)

	return p79
end

local t3: {[any]: any} = {}

local function showSearchResults(p42)
	for _, v in ipairs(t3) do
		v:Destroy()
	end

	table.clear(t3)

	local lowerText = p42:lower()
	local t13: {[any]: any} = {}

	for _, v in ipairs(t2) do
		if lowerText == "" or v.l:lower():find(lowerText, 1, true) or v.d:lower():find(lowerText, 1, true) then
			table.insert(t13, v)

			if #t13 >= 8 then
				break
			end
		end

local function u137()
	u1 = nil
	u135()
	u136()
	textLabel.Text = "All Players Selected"
	textLabel.Visible = true

	local players2 = players:GetPlayers()

	v126.Text = "[broadcast]"
	v128.Text = "n/a"
	v131.Text = tostring(#players2) .. " online"
end
local function u138(player)
	if player == u1 then
		return
	end

	u1 = player
	u135()
	u136()
	v126.Text = player.Name
	v127.Text = player.DisplayName
	v128.Text = tostring(player.UserId)
	v129.Text = player.AccountAge .. "d"
	v133.Text = if player.MembershipType == Enum.MembershipType.Premium then "yes" else "no"

	local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
		return player:IsFriendsWith(LocalPlayer.UserId)
	end)

	v134.Text = if ok3 and result3 then "yes" else "no"

	local Character = player.Character

	if not Character then
		textLabel.Text = "No Character"
		textLabel.Visible = true

		return
	end

	local characterArchivable = Character.Archivable

	Character.Archivable = true

	local clone = Character:Clone()

	Character.Archivable = characterArchivable

	if not clone then
		textLabel.Text = "Clone Failed"
		textLabel.Visible = true

		return
	end

	for _, v in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("Script") or v:IsA("LocalScript") or v:IsA("ModuleScript") or v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("Smoke") then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for _, v in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			v.Anchored = true
		end
	end

	clone.Parent = worldModel
	pcall(function()
		clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 0, 0))
	end)
	u96 = clone
	n2 = 0

	local pivot = clone:GetPivot()

	vectorValue = Vector3.new(0, pivot.Position.Y, 0)

	local n1 = vectorValue.Y + 0.4
	local cFrameNew = CFrame.new
	local vector3 = Vector3.new(0, n1, 4.8)
	local vector32 = Vector3.new(0, n1, 0)

	camera.CFrame = cFrameNew(vector3, vector32)
	textLabel.Visible = false

	local humanoid = clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if humanoid then
		local rounded = math.round(humanoid.Health)
		local rounded2 = math.round(humanoid.MaxHealth)

		v131.Text = rounded .. "/" .. rounded2
	end

	v132.Text = player.Team and player.Team.Name or "none"
end
local function selectTarget(p51)
	if p51 == nil then

		return
	end

	u138(p51)
end

local foundChild = nil
local frame17 = nil

v12.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(p84, p85)
	local t20 = type(p85) == "table" and p85 or {}

	if p84 == "spectate" then
		foundChild = players:FindFirstChild(t20.name or "")
	elseif p84 == "stopSpectate" then
		foundChild = nil

		local CurrentCamera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom

		local Character: Model = LocalPlayer.Character

		CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
	elseif p84 == "shake" then
		local CurrentCamera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local currentCameraCFrame: CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame

		for _ = 1, 12 do
			local cFrameAngles = CFrame.Angles
			local randomNumber = math.random(-4, 4)
			local v783 = math.rad(randomNumber)
			local randomNumber2 = math.random(-4, 4)
			local v785 = math.rad(randomNumber2)
			local cFrame = cFrameAngles(v783, v785, 0)

			CurrentCamera.CFrame = currentCameraCFrame * cFrame
			task.wait(0.04)
		end

		CurrentCamera.CFrame = currentCameraCFrame
	elseif p84 == "blind" then
		if t20.on ~= false then
			if not frame17 then
				local _AdminBlindGui: ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

				_AdminBlindGui.Name = "_AdminBlindGui"
				_AdminBlindGui.DisplayOrder = 200
				_AdminBlindGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
				_AdminBlindGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
				_AdminBlindGui.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
				frame17 = Instance.new("Frame")
				frame17.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
				frame17.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				frame17.BorderSizePixel = 0
				frame17.Name = "_AdminBlind"
				frame17.Parent = _AdminBlindGui
			end

			frame17.Parent.Enabled = true

			return
		end

		if frame17 then
			frame17.Parent.Enabled = false

			return
		end
	else
		if p84 == "modNotify" then
			adminLib.Notify({
				Duration = 4,
				Title = t20.title or "Admin",
				Message = t20.msg or "",
				Type = t20.style or "info"
			})

			return
		end

		if p84 == "broadcast" then
			adminLib.Notify({
				Type = "warning",
				Duration = 4,
				Title = "[BROADCAST] " .. (t20.sender or "Admin"),
				Message = t20.text or ""
			})

			return
		end

		if p84 ~= "srvNotify" then
			if p84 ~= "adminLog" then
				if p84 ~= "adminChat" then
					if p84 == "fly" then
						if t20.enabled then
							if connection then
								connection:Disconnect()
							end

							local Character: Model = LocalPlayer.Character

							if not Character then
								return
							end

							local humanoidRootPart: Instance = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
							local humanoid: Instance = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

							if humanoidRootPart and humanoid then
								local adminFlyBV: BodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

								adminFlyBV.Name = "AdminFlyBV"
								adminFlyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
								adminFlyBV.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
								adminFlyBV.Parent = humanoidRootPart

								local adminFlyBG: BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")

								adminFlyBG.Name = "AdminFlyBG"
								adminFlyBG.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
								adminFlyBG.D = 100
								adminFlyBG.Parent = humanoidRootPart

								local userInputService: UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
								local CurrentCamera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

								connection = runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
									if not humanoidRootPart.Parent then
										connection:Disconnect()
										connection = nil

										return
									end

									local isKeyDown: boolean = userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
									local v1099 = humanoid.MoveDirection

									if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
										v1099 += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
									end

									if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
										v1099 -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
									end

									if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA) then
										v1099 += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
									end

									if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB) then
										v1099 -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
									end

									if v1099.Magnitude <= 0 then
										local humanoidMoveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection

										if humanoidMoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
											v1099 += humanoidMoveDirection
										end
									end

									adminFlyBV.Velocity = v1099.Magnitude > 0 and v1099.Unit * (if isKeyDown then 80 else 40) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
									adminFlyBG.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame
								end)

								return
							end

							return
						end

						if connection then
							connection:Disconnect()
							connection = nil
						end

						local Character: Model = LocalPlayer.Character

						if not Character then
							return
						end

						local humanoidRootPart: Instance = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if not humanoidRootPart then
							return
						end

						local adminFlyBV: Instance = humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("AdminFlyBV")

						if adminFlyBV then
							adminFlyBV:Destroy()
						end

						local adminFlyBG: Instance = humanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("AdminFlyBG")

						if adminFlyBG then
							adminFlyBG:Destroy()
						end
					end
				elseif u25 then
					u25(t20)

					return
				end
			elseif u24 then
				u24(t20.text or "")

				return
			end
		elseif t20.type == "error" then
			adminLib.Notify({
				Title = "Server Error",
				Type = "error",
				Duration = 4,
				Message = t20.msg or ""
			})

			return
		end
	end
end)
runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not foundChild then
		return
	end

	local Character = foundChild.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if humanoidRootPart then
		local CurrentCamera: Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

		local humanoidRootPartCFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
		local v803 = CFrame.Angles(-0.1, 0, 0)

		CurrentCamera.CFrame = humanoidRootPartCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 8) * v803
	end
end)

color37(color311.Box, "Lookup Player Record", "accent", function(p93)
	local v824 = mkField(p93, "Name or User ID", "e.g. Roblox or 12345")

	mkRun(p93, "Lookup", "accent", function()
		local v1113 = v824:Get()

		if v1113 == "" then
			if u1 and u1.Parent == game.Players then
				v1113 = u1.UserId
			else
				adminLib.Notify({
					Title = "Error",
					Message = "Enter or Select a player.",
					Type = "error",
					Duration = 4
				})
			end
		end

		local numberValue: number? = tonumber(v1113)
		local t24: {[any]: any} = { name = v1113, userId = numberValue }
		local v1117

		if not adminModQuery then
			v1117 = nil
		else
			local s1: string = "getRecord"

			local ok6, result6 = pcall(function()
				return adminModQuery:InvokeServer(s1, t24 or {})
			end)

			v1117 = ok6 and result6 or nil
		end

		if not v1117 or not v1117.ok then
			adminLib.Notify({
				Title = "Error",
				Message = "Player not found or offline.",
				Type = "error",
				Duration = 4
			})

			return
		end

		local record = v1117.record
		t24 = {
			"Player: " .. v1117.name .. " (" .. v1117.userId .. ")",
			"Warnings: " .. #record.warns,
			"Kicks: " .. #record.kicks,
			"Mutes: " .. #record.mutes,
			"Bans: " .. #record.bans,
			"Watchlist: " .. (if record.watchlist then "YES" else "No")
		}

		if #record.warns > 0 then
			local v1121 = record.warns[#record.warns]

			table.insert(t24, "Last warn: [" .. v1121.reason .. "] by " .. v1121.admin)
		end

		if #record.bans > 0 then
			local v1122 = record.bans[#record.bans]

			table.insert(t24, "Last ban: [" .. v1122.reason .. "] by " .. v1122.admin)
		end

		local s2: string = "Record: " .. v1117.name
		local v1124 = table.concat(t24, " | ")

		adminLib.Notify({ Type = "info", Duration = 4, Title = s2, Message = v1124 })
	end)
end)

local function ts()
	local dateText = os.date("*t")

	return string.format("[%02d:%02d:%02d]", dateText.hour, dateText.min, dateText.sec)
end

color38 = function(parent)
	local frame19: Frame = Instance.new("Frame")

	frame19.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame19.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	frame19.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	frame19.Parent = parent

	local uiListLayout: UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

	uiListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 1)
	uiListLayout.Parent = frame19

	return frame19
end

local function addRow(parent, list, text, p99)
	local textLabel13: TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	textLabel13.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textLabel13.BorderSizePixel = 0
	textLabel13.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0)
	textLabel13.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	textLabel13.Text = text
	textLabel13.TextColor3 = p99 or t1.TextSub
	textLabel13.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	textLabel13.TextSize = 10
	textLabel13.TextWrapped = true
	textLabel13.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	textLabel13.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
	textLabel13.Parent = parent
	table.insert(list, textLabel13)

	if #list > 150 then
		list[1]:Destroy()
		table.remove(list, 1)
	end
end

local function fmtUptime(p115)
	local floored = math.floor(p115 / 3600)
	local floored4 = math.floor(p115 % 3600 / 60)

	return string.format("%dh %02dm %02ds", floored, floored4, p115 % 60)
end
local function refreshThisServer()
	local v910

	if not adminSrvQuery then
		v910 = nil
	else
		local s1: string = "thisServer"
		local v911 = nil

		local ok7, result7 = pcall(function()
			return adminSrvQuery:InvokeServer(s1, v911 or {})
		end)

		v910 = ok7 and result7 or nil
	end

	if not v910 or not v910.ok then
		v180.Text = "Error fetching"

		return
	end

	v180.Text = string.sub(v910.jobId or "—", 1, 22) .. "..."
	v181.Text = tostring(v910.placeId)
	v182.Text = "v" .. tostring(v910.placeVersion)

	local text: string = tostring(v910.playerCount)
	local text2: string = tostring(v910.maxPlayers)

	v183.Text = text .. " / " .. text2

	local v916 = v910.uptime or 0
	local floored = math.floor(v916 / 3600)
	local floored5 = math.floor(v916 % 3600 / 60)

	v184.Text = string.format("%dh %02dm %02ds", floored, floored5, v916 % 60)
end

	Title = "Refresh Info",
	Style = "accent",
	Desc = "Fetch live server stats",
	Callback = function()
		refreshThisServer()
	end
})

fmtUptime = function(p123, p124)
	local v950 = t8[p123]

	if not v950 then
		return
	end

	local t21: {[any]: any} = {}

	for k, v in pairs(v950) do
		if t1[k] then
			local v954 = t1[k]
			local floored = math.floor(v954.R * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored8 = math.floor(v954.G * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored9 = math.floor(v954.B * 255 + 0.5)

			t21[floored .. "," .. floored8 .. "," .. floored9] = v
		end
	end

	for k, v in pairs(v950) do
		t1[k] = v
	end

	s1 = p123

	for _, v in ipairs(LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("GuiObject") and v.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then
			local vBackgroundColor3 = v.BackgroundColor3
			local floored = math.floor(vBackgroundColor3.R * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored10 = math.floor(vBackgroundColor3.G * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored11 = math.floor(vBackgroundColor3.B * 255 + 0.5)
			local backgroundColor3 = t21[floored .. "," .. floored10 .. "," .. floored11]

			if backgroundColor3 then
				v.BackgroundColor3 = backgroundColor3
			end
		end

		if v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextButton") or v:IsA("TextBox") then
			local vTextColor3 = v.TextColor3
			local floored = math.floor(vTextColor3.R * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored12 = math.floor(vTextColor3.G * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored13 = math.floor(vTextColor3.B * 255 + 0.5)
			local textColor3 = t21[floored .. "," .. floored12 .. "," .. floored13]

			if textColor3 then
				v.TextColor3 = textColor3
			end
		end

		if v:IsA("ImageLabel") or v:IsA("ImageButton") then
			local vImageColor3 = v.ImageColor3
			local floored = math.floor(vImageColor3.R * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored14 = math.floor(vImageColor3.G * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored15 = math.floor(vImageColor3.B * 255 + 0.5)
			local imageColor3 = t21[floored .. "," .. floored14 .. "," .. floored15]

			if imageColor3 then
				v.ImageColor3 = imageColor3
			end
		end

		if v:IsA("UIStroke") then
			local vColor = v.Color
			local floored = math.floor(vColor.R * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored16 = math.floor(vColor.G * 255 + 0.5)
			local floored17 = math.floor(vColor.B * 255 + 0.5)
			local v981 = t21[floored .. "," .. floored16 .. "," .. floored17]

			if v981 then
				v.Color = v981
			end
		end
	end

	if not p124 then
		adminLib.Notify({
			Title = "Theme",
			Type = "success",
			Duration = 4,
			Message = p123 .. " applied."
		})
	end
end

v180 = function()
	if not u1 then
		adminLib.Notify({
			Title = "Error",
			Message = "Select a player first.",
			Type = "error",
			Duration = 4
		})

		return
	end

	local textBox4Text: string = textBox4.Text

	if textBox4Text == "" or textBox4Text:match("^%s*$") then
		adminLib.Notify({
			Title = "Error",
			Message = "Enter what you want to gift.",
			Type = "error",
			Duration = 4
		})

		return
	end

	adminRemote:FireServer("gift", u1.Name, { item = textBox4Text, amount = textBox5.Text })
	adminLib.Notify({
		Title = "Gift Sent",
		Message = "Sent gift command to server.",
		Type = "success",
		Duration = 4
	})
	textBox4.Text = ""
	textBox5.Text = ""
end

	MasterScale = 1,
	LockedToGui = false,
	EmissionDirection = 0,
	ResampleMode = "Default",
	Paused = false,
	RotationSpeed = NumberRange.new(0),
	LifeTime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.7)
}

for key2, value2 in t5 do
	migrateAttributes(t6)

	if n1 >= value2.Version then
		local v44 = ("Version lower or equal to previous, did you forget to change it? [Migration #%*, v%* <= v%*]"):format(key2, value2.Version, n1)

		error(v44)
	elseif version < value2.Version then
		local v45 = ("Version higher than installed version, did you forget to update the config version attribute? [Migration #%*, v%* <= v%*]"):format(key2, value2.Version, version)

		error(v45)
	end

	n1 = value2.Version
end

for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in scriptEmitter:GetAttributes() do
	local typeName: string = typeof(iterSecond2)
	local typeName2: string = typeof(t6[iterFirst2])

	if typeName ~= typeName2 then
		local typeName3: string = typeof(t6[iterFirst2])
		local typeName4: string = typeof(iterSecond2)
		local v52 = ("Final migration check type mismatch for attribute '%*': [%* ~= %*]"):format(iterFirst2, typeName3, typeName4)

		error(v52)
	end
end

							if u431 == true then
								u431 = false

							u431 = true

							v434.NotVisibleCount = v434.NotVisibleCount - 1

							if not v430.Enabled then

							p35.ZIndexBehavior = v430.ZIndexBehavior

						if not v430.Enabled then
							if u431 == true then
								u431 = false

								local v435 = p35

					if v430 ~= v420 and attributes.IgnoreClipsDescendants == false and v430:IsA("GuiObject") then
						local u437 = false

						local function CheckClipped()
							local absolutePosition = v420.AbsolutePosition
							local absoluteSize = v420.AbsoluteSize
							local v472 = v430.AbsolutePosition
							local v473 = v430.AbsoluteSize
							local u474: boolean = true

							if not (v472.x > absolutePosition.x + absoluteSize.x) then
								u474 = true

								if not (v472.x + v473.x < absolutePosition.x) then
									u474 = true

									if not (v472.y > absolutePosition.y + absoluteSize.y) then
										u474 = v472.y + v473.y < absolutePosition.y
									end
								end
							end

							if u437 == not not u474 then
								return
							end

							if u437 then
								u437 = false

								local v475 = p35

								v475.ClipCount = v475.ClipCount - 1

								return
							end

							u437 = true

							local v476 = p35

							v476.ClipCount = v476.ClipCount + 1
						end
						local function UpdateClipsDescendants()
							if v430:IsA("GuiObject") == false or v430.ClipsDescendants then
								t10.SizeChanged = v430:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(CheckClipped)
								t10.ParentPositionChanged = v420:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(CheckClipped)

								local absolutePosition = v420.AbsolutePosition
								local absoluteSize = v420.AbsoluteSize
								local v479 = v430.AbsolutePosition
								local v480 = v430.AbsoluteSize
								local u481: boolean = true

								if not (v479.x > absolutePosition.x + absoluteSize.x) then
									u481 = true

									if not (v479.x + v480.x < absolutePosition.x) then
										u481 = true

										if not (v479.y > absolutePosition.y + absoluteSize.y) then
											u481 = v479.y + v480.y < absolutePosition.y
										end
									end
								end

								if u437 ~= not not u481 then
									if u437 then
										u437 = false

										local v482 = p35

										v482.ClipCount = v482.ClipCount - 1

										return
									end

									u437 = true

									local v483 = p35

									v483.ClipCount = v483.ClipCount + 1

									return
								end
							else
								if t10.SizeChanged then
									t10.SizeChanged:Disconnect()
								end

								if t10.ParentPositionChanged then
									t10.ParentPositionChanged:Disconnect()
								end

								if u437 then
									u437 = false

									local v484 = p35

									v484.ClipCount = v484.ClipCount - 1
								end
							end
						end

						t10.ClipsDescendantsChanged = v430:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ClipsDescendants"):Connect(UpdateClipsDescendants)
						UpdateClipsDescendants()
					end

					p35.AncestorEvents[v428] = t10
				end

				v428 = v428.Parent
			end
		else
			if p35.AncestorEvents then
				for iterFirst3, iterSecond3 in p35.AncestorEvents, nil, nil do

					end

				p35.AncestorEvents = nil

				u431 = p35

				u431 = " Emitter must be parented to a gui object!"
				warn(text .. u431)
			end
		end

		p35.ValidAncestry = u422
	end

	p35.Events.AncestryChanged = parent.AncestryChanged:Connect(UpdateRenderable)
	p35.Events.IgnoreClipsDescendantsChanged = parent:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IgnoreClipsDescendants"):Connect(UpdateRenderable)
	UpdateRenderable()
	UpdateRenderable = parent:FindFirstChild("Emit") or Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	p35.Events.EmitFired = UpdateRenderable.Event:Connect(function(p40)
		if p35.ValidAncestry then
			for _ = 1, p40 or 1 do
				p35:SpawnParticle()
			end
		else
			local text: string = tostring(p35)

			warn(text .. "Cannot emit particles while emitter is inactive. Make sure the emitter is parented to a gui in the players PlayerGui.")
		end
	end)
	UpdateRenderable.Name = "Emit"
	UpdateRenderable.Archivable = false
	UpdateRenderable.Parent = parent
	table.insert(p35.Bindables, UpdateRenderable)
	UpdateRenderable = parent:FindFirstChild("TimeStep") or Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	p35.Events.TimeStepFired = UpdateRenderable.Event:Connect(function(p41)
		if p35.ValidAncestry then
			p35:Update(p41)

			return
		end

		local text: string = tostring(p35)

		warn(text .. "Cannot update time while emitter is inactive. Make sure the emitter is parented to a gui in the players PlayerGui.")
	end)
	UpdateRenderable.Name = "TimeStep"
	UpdateRenderable.Archivable = false
	UpdateRenderable.Parent = parent
	table.insert(p35.Bindables, UpdateRenderable)
	UpdateRenderable = parent:FindFirstChild("SetSeeds") or Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	p35.Events.SetSeedsFired = UpdateRenderable.Event:Connect(function(p42)
		local typeName5: string = typeof(p42)

		assert(typeName5 == "table", "First argument must be a table of seeds with the keys being the seed names and the values being the seed number.")

		local u452: boolean = false

		for iterFirst, iterSecond in p42 do
			if p35.SpawnRandomizers[iterFirst] then
				p35.SpawnRandomizers[iterFirst] = Random.new(iterSecond)
			else
				u452 = true

				warn(v455)
			end
		end

		if u452 then
			local s1: string = ""

			for iterFirst2, iterSecond2 in p35.SpawnRandomizers, nil, nil do
				local v459 = ("%*, "):format(iterFirst2)

				s1 ..= v459
			end

			local v460 = ("Valid seed keys: %*"):format((s1:sub(1, -3)))

		end

function t6.SpawnParticle(p43, p44, p45)
	local attributes = p43.Attributes
	local spawnRandomizers = p43.SpawnRandomizers
	local v169 = attributes.EmissionDirection
	local ConfigParent = p43.Config.Parent
	local v171 = p43.Cache[p43.CacheCount]

	if v171 then
		p43.Cache[p43.CacheCount] = nil
		p43.CacheCount = p43.CacheCount - 1
	else
		v171 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	end

	v171.Name = "Particle"
	v171.Image = attributes.Texture
	v171.Archivable = false
	v171.Interactable = false
	v171.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	v171.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	v171.ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode[attributes.ResampleMode]

	local min = attributes.Size.Min
	local n1 = attributes.Size.Max - attributes.Size.Min
	local v174 = spawnRandomizers.Size:NextNumber()
	local v175 = attributes.Depth.Min
	local n2 = attributes.Depth.Max - attributes.Depth.Min
	local v177 = spawnRandomizers.Depth:NextNumber()
	local v178 = attributes.LifeTime.Min
	local n3 = attributes.LifeTime.Max - attributes.LifeTime.Min
	local v180 = spawnRandomizers.LifeTime:NextNumber()
	local v181 = attributes.Rotation.Min
	local n4 = attributes.Rotation.Max - attributes.Rotation.Min
	local v183 = spawnRandomizers.Rotation:NextNumber()
	local v184 = attributes.RotationSpeed.Min
	local n5 = attributes.RotationSpeed.Max - attributes.RotationSpeed.Min
	local v186 = spawnRandomizers.RotationSpeed:NextNumber()
	local t9: {[any]: any} = {
		Time = 0,
		ParticleGui = v171,
		ParentGui = ConfigParent,
		Events = {},
		Position = p44,
		Velocity = p45,
		Size = min + n1 * v174,
		Depth = v175 + n2 * v177,
		LifeTime = v178 + n3 * v180,
		Rotation = v181 + n4 * v183,
		RotationSpeed = v184 + n5 * v186
	}

	if p44 == nil then
		local absoluteRotation = p43.AbsoluteRotation
		local absolutePosition = p43.AbsolutePosition
		local absoluteSize = p43.AbsoluteSize
		local spawnRandomizersPosition = spawnRandomizers.Position

		if attributes.EmissionShape == "Rectangle" then
			if attributes.EmissionShapeStyle == "Volume" then
				local vector2New = Vector2.new
				local absoluteSizeX = absoluteSize.X
				local v194 = spawnRandomizersPosition:NextNumber()
				local absoluteSizeY = absoluteSize.Y
				local v196 = spawnRandomizersPosition:NextNumber()

				p44 = vector2New(absoluteSizeX * v194, absoluteSizeY * v196)
			elseif attributes.EmissionShapeStyle == "Surface" then
				local u197: boolean = spawnRandomizersPosition:NextNumber() <= absoluteSize.Y / (absoluteSize.X + absoluteSize.Y)
				local v198 = spawnRandomizersPosition:NextInteger(0, 1)
				local v199 = Vector2.new
				local n6 = if u197 then absoluteSize.X * v198 else absoluteSize.X * spawnRandomizersPosition:NextNumber()
				local n7 = if u197 then absoluteSize.Y * spawnRandomizersPosition:NextNumber() else absoluteSize.Y * v198

				p44 = v199(n6, n7)

				if attributes.EmissionDirectionMode == "FromSurface" then
					v169 = if u197 then if v198 == 0 then v169 - 90 else v169 + 90 else if v198 == 0 then v169 + 0 else v169 + 180
				end
			else
				local text: string = tostring(p43)

				error(text .. "Invalid EmissionShapeStyle")
			end
		elseif attributes.EmissionShape == "Point" then
			p44 = absoluteSize * 0.5

			if attributes.EmissionDirectionMode == "FromSurface" then
				local v203 = spawnRandomizers.Rotation:NextNumber(0, 360)

				v169 += v203
			end
		elseif attributes.EmissionShape == "Oval" then
			local v204 = spawnRandomizersPosition:NextNumber()
			local v205 = math.rad(360 * v204)
			local n8 = if attributes.EmissionShapeStyle == "Volume" then 0.5 * spawnRandomizersPosition:NextNumber() ^ 0.5 else 0.5
			local v207 = Vector2.new
			local cosine = math.cos(v205)
			local sine = math.sin(v205)
			local v210 = v207(0.5 + cosine * n8, 0.5 + sine * n8)

			p44 = absoluteSize * v210

			if attributes.EmissionDirectionMode == "FromSurface" then
				local vector2 = Vector2.new(ellipseNormalAtPoint(absoluteSize.X, absoluteSize.Y, p44.X - absoluteSize.X / 2, p44.Y - absoluteSize.Y / 2))
				local v212 = math.atan2(vector2.X, -vector2.Y)
				local v213 = math.deg(v212)

				if v213 < math.huge == false then
					v213 = 0
				end

				v169 += v213
			end
		else
			local text: string = tostring(p43)

			error(text .. "Invalid EmissionShape")
		end

		t9.Position = p44
	end

	if attributes.EmissionDirectionMode == "FromCenter" then
		local unit = (t9.Position - ConfigParent.AbsoluteSize / 2).Unit
		local v216 = math.atan2(unit.X, -unit.Y)
		local v217 = math.deg(v216)

		if v217 < math.huge == false then
			v217 = 0
		end

		v169 += v217
	end

	if p45 == nil then
		local attributesSpreadAngle = attributes.SpreadAngle
		local v219 = spawnRandomizers.SpreadAngle:NextNumber()
		local v220 = math.rad(v169 - 90 + attributesSpreadAngle * (v219 - 0.5) * 2)
		local v221 = attributes.Speed.Min

		v219 = attributes.Speed.Max - attributes.Speed.Min

		local v222 = spawnRandomizers.Speed:NextNumber()
		local n9 = v221 + v219 * v222
		local v224 = Vector2.new
		local cosine = math.cos(v220)
		local sine = math.sin(v220)

		t9.Velocity = v224(cosine * n9, sine * n9)
	end

	local attributesFlipbookFramerate = attributes.FlipbookFramerate
	local attributesFlipbookFramerateMin = attributesFlipbookFramerate.Min

	n5 = spawnRandomizers.FlipbookFramerate:NextNumber()
	t9.FlipbookFramerate = attributesFlipbookFramerateMin + n5 * (attributesFlipbookFramerate.Max - attributesFlipbookFramerate.Min)

	if attributes.FlipbookStartRandom then
		t9.FlipbookStartFrame = spawnRandomizers.FlipbookStartRandom:NextNumber(1, t3[attributes.FlipbookLayout])
	else
		t9.FlipbookStartFrame = 1
	end

	t9.FlipbookFrame = t9.FlipbookStartFrame
	t9.ScaleSequence = generateSequence(attributes.Scale, spawnRandomizers.Scale:NextNumber())
	t9.ScaleSequenceIndex = 1
	t9.SquashSequence = generateSequence(attributes.Squash, spawnRandomizers.Squash:NextNumber())
	t9.SquashSequenceIndex = 1
	t9.TransparencySequence = generateSequence(attributes.Transparency, spawnRandomizers.Transparency:NextNumber())
	t9.TransparencySequenceIndex = 1
	t9.ColorSequence = generateSequence(attributes.Color, spawnRandomizers.Color:NextNumber())
	t9.ColorSequenceIndex = 1

	if attributes.Depth.Min ~= attributes.Depth.Max then
		t9.DepthTransparencySequence = generateSequence(attributes.DepthTransparency, spawnRandomizers.DepthTransparency:NextNumber())
		t9.DepthTransparencySequenceIndex = 1
	end

	p43.Particles[v171] = t9
	p43.ParticleCount = p43.ParticleCount + 1

	if u10 then
		v171:AddTag("Emitter2D_Particle")
	end

	return t9
end

		return

		report("gui:" .. p2.Name)

		return

	local title = panel and panel:FindFirstChild("Title")

	if title and title:IsA("TextLabel") and title.Text:find("Babis") then
		report("gui:BabisPremiumLoader")
	end
end

function animateTool()
	if s3 == "None" then
		playToolAnimation("toolnone", 0.1, humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
	elseif s3 == "Slash" then
		playToolAnimation("toolslash", 0, humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)
	elseif s3 == "Lunge" then
		playToolAnimation("toollunge", 0, humanoid, Enum.AnimationPriority.Action)

		return
	end
end
function moveSit()
	rightShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
	leftShoulder.MaxVelocity = 0.15
	rightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
	leftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
	rightHip:SetDesiredAngle(1.57)
	leftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-1.57)
end

local n4 = 0

function move(p21)
	local n1: number = 1
	local n5: number = 1
	local n6 = p21 - n4

	n4 = p21

	local u85 = false

	if n3 > 0 then
		n3 -= n6
	end

	if s1 == "FreeFall" and n3 <= 0 then
		playAnimation("fall", 0.3, humanoid)
	else
		if s1 == "Seated" then
			playAnimation("sit", 0.5, humanoid)

			return
		end

		if s1 == "Running" then
			playAnimation("walk", 0.1, humanoid)
		elseif s1 == "Dead" or s1 == "GettingUp" or s1 == "FallingDown" or s1 == "Seated" or s1 == "PlatformStanding" then
			stopAllAnimations()
			n1 = 0.1
			n5 = 1
			u85 = true
		end
	end

	if u85 then
		local sine = math.sin(p21 * n5)
		local n7 = n1 * sine

		rightShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(n7 + 0)
		leftShoulder:SetDesiredAngle(n7 - 0)
		rightHip:SetDesiredAngle(-n7)
		leftHip:SetDesiredAngle(-n7)
	end

	u85 = getTool()

	if u85 and u85:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
		local toolAnim = getToolAnim(u85)

		if toolAnim then
			s3 = toolAnim.Value
			toolAnim.Parent = nil
			n2 = p21 + 0.3
		end

		if p21 > n2 then
			n2 = 0
			s3 = "None"
		end

		animateTool()

		return
	end

	stopToolAnimations()
	s3 = "None"
	u32 = nil
	n2 = 0
end
